authority: This repository: middleware/error_handler.py (_map_status_to_error_code) and utils/error_codes.py (ErrorCode). Pinned by tests/test_order_create_prologue_refusals_contract.py. The agent gateway's model of this backend's error envelope vendors this file byte-identical.
meaning: For an error a route raises, error.code and the default error.message are chosen by the HTTP status alone. A status not listed is answered with the 500 entry. A 422 (request validation) is answered as HTTP 400 with the 400 code and the message in `validation_message`.

403: You don't have permission to access this resource
409: Request conflicts with the current state of the resource
429: Too many requests, please try again later
